Payments.title: Payment methods

papi.intro: With Papi, your clients pay your invoices in ariary by MVola, Orange Money or Airtel Money, in one tap from the invoice page. The money goes to your Papi account: Ivonea OS never touches it.
papi.disconnectConfirm: Your clients will no longer see the “Pay with Papi” button. Your key and secret are erased from Ivonea OS. A client who still pays a link they already opened will still be recorded. Your MVola number and bank details stay on your invoices.
papi.needsReconnect: Papi no longer recognises your key (revoked or regenerated). The “Pay with Papi” button has been removed from your invoices: paste your new key below to bring it back.

results.connected: Papi connected. Your next invoices in ariary will have a “Pay with Papi” button.
results.invalid_key: Papi doesn't recognise this key. Copy the whole “API key” from your shop's Developer tab again.
results.invalid_key_format: This doesn't look like a Papi key: it is too short or contains spaces. Copy the whole key again.
results.invalid_secret: This doesn't look like a Papi signing secret. It starts with “pwhsec_” followed by 64 characters.
results.unavailable: Papi isn't responding right now. Check your connection and try again in a few minutes.
results.disabled: Connecting Papi isn't enabled on Ivonea OS yet. Your MVola number and bank details stay on your invoices.
results.error: Something went wrong while saving your connection. Please try again in a moment.

guide.title: Connect Papi in 5 steps

account.title: Open your Papi account
account.body: Sign up on Papi's website. Papi will ask for documents to check your identity and business, and charges a fee on each payment: check the list of documents and the fees directly with Papi before you start.

shop.title: Create your shop
shop.body: In Papi, a “shop” (or application) receives your payments. Create it once your account is approved.

key.title: Copy your API key
key.body: Tap your avatar at the top right, then “Shops”, pick your shop and open the “Developer” tab. Copy the long string under “API key”.

secret.title: Copy your signing secret
secret.body: Just below, under “Notification signing secret”, copy the secret starting with “pwhsec_”. It lets Ivonea OS check that each payment really comes from Papi.

paste.title: Paste them here
paste.body: Ivonea OS checks your key with Papi, then stores it encrypted. Nobody can read it back, not even you: to change it, paste a new key.

guide.replaceHint: With the key of another shop, the Papi links already sent are replaced: your clients will pay into the new shop.

form.privacy: Your key and secret are encrypted and never shown again. Never send them by WhatsApp or email.

whop.title: Card payment (Whop)
whop.intro: For your invoices in euros or dollars, your client pays by bank card in one click from the invoice page. The money goes to your Whop account, which takes a fee on each payment. {fee, plural, =0 {Ivonea OS takes nothing.} other {Ivonea OS also takes {fee}% of each card payment.}} Whop will ask you to verify your identity.
